column1: BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, I, Mangala
Samaraweera,  Minister of Finance of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, do by this order impose in respect
of the list of  commodities specified in Column I of the Schedule hereto a Special Commodity Levy, at the rates specified
in the corresponding entries in Column II of that Schedule.
This Order shall be valid for a period of 06 months commencing from November 08, 2019 subject to provisions
of Sub section (3) of Section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007.
